hero.headline: Engineering Solutions

about.heading:
Engineering Expertise
You Can Rely On
body: We are a Tanzanian engineering and technical services firm staffed by qualified engineers and technicians across multiple disciplines.
We apply international engineering standards with deep local knowledge to deliver safe, efficient, and cost-effective solutions for our clients.

items.title: Electrical Engineering
items.body: Electrical installation, maintenance, and design for commercial and industrial properties.

items.title: Mechanical Engineering
items.body: Mechanical systems design, installation, and maintenance for industrial and commercial facilities.

items.title: Structural Engineering
items.body: Structural design, assessment, and advisory for buildings and infrastructure projects.

items.title: ICT & Networking
items.body: Network infrastructure, IT systems, and technology integration for businesses.

items.title: Surveying & Estimation
items.body: Quantity surveying, cost estimation, and BOQ preparation for construction and engineering projects.

items.title: Maintenance Services
items.body: Preventive and corrective maintenance programmes for electrical, mechanical, and civil assets.

items.title: Qualified Engineers
items.body: All our engineers hold recognised professional qualifications and current registrations.

items.title: Code Compliant
items.body: All work is designed and executed to meet applicable Tanzanian and international standards.

items.title: Health & Safety First
items.body: We maintain rigorous health and safety standards on every project and work site.

items.title: Detailed Engineering
items.body: We invest in thorough design and planning to prevent costly errors and rework.

items.title: Responsive Support
items.body: Our technical team is available for urgent call-outs and fast-turnaround repairs.

items.title: Value Engineering
items.body: We identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality or safety.
